notes.solar: KGPV's published irradiation thresholds are retained; equality belongs to the lower solar class.
notes.pv: PV temperature is monthly-GHI-weighted ambient temperature, not module or cell temperature. Below 10 C is cool; above 25 C is hot; equality is mild. Provisional screening thresholds.
notes.season: Weakest month's mean daily irradiation divided by annual mean daily irradiation. Below 0.35 is strongly seasonal; 0.35 to below 0.75 is seasonal; at least 0.75 is steady. Provisional thresholds.
notes.bess: Cold if the coldest monthly mean is below 5 C; hot if the warmest monthly mean exceeds 30 C. These are ambient climate screening thresholds, not battery operating limits or HVAC predictions.
notes.hybrid: Combines solar seasonality and ambient thermal regime. It does not calculate optimal storage duration, autonomy, revenue or battery life. Those require hourly PV, load, dispatch and technology data.
